init.title: Set up work area
init.imperative: Run: python C:/Users/fredc/.claude/skills/constellation-commander/scripts/init_work_area.py 451. Start the work branch per repo guidance. Claim the engine session lease on this spine so a resumed or duplicated parent cannot concurrently drive it: <engine> claim --session-id <commander-session-id> --claimed-by commander --worktree . (if a stale prior lease blocks you, re-run with --force --reason "resuming this run"). From here on, pass --session-id <commander-session-id> on every mutating engine call against this spine.

postconditions.statement: engine session lease claimed for this spine (commander owns the state)

context.title: Load baseline context
context.imperative: Read docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, docs/agents/engine-config.json. Read the Active section of .agent-work/LESSONS.md if it exists: these are distilled workflow lessons from prior runs — condition planning and handoff authoring on them, and note any lesson this run's evidence contradicts (it becomes a disconfirm op at the feedback step). Read the current map (packets, overlays, decision anchors) for the area the ask touches; this read is the map-first input the mission frame and plan are built from. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context, glossary, engine config loaded; current map read for the affected area where architecture artifacts exist

understand.title: Understand the ask
understand.imperative: In your own context (the interrogator must reach the human), load constellation-interrogator and drive interrogation.json with the request, context, and commander starting questions; frame the ask map-first against the affected capabilities, structural anchors, and governing constraints/decisions read at context, and flag any low-confidence/stale/disputed map area the ask depends on. Save the consolidated problem statement. Confirm it with the human.

postconditions.statement: problem statement and protected intent confirmed

payload.decision: Problem statement ratified by Admiral launch order LO-451; intent and scope confirmed as written
payload.statement: Localize race_weekend quali under-extraction to (a) representation / (b) training signal / (c) capacity on the §7.6.2 same-pairs harness; ship fix only if small

plan.title: Author the gate plan
plan.imperative: Map-first: BEFORE authoring execute.json, produce a mission frame from the current map using templates/MISSION_FRAME.template.md (intent; affected capabilities; relevant examples/events; structural anchors; governing constraints/assumptions; decision anchors and decision pressure; claims/evidence surfaces; map confidence/staleness/disputes; out of scope). For a trivial local/mechanical change where the map adds nothing, shrink or skip the frame and say so in its intent. For any low-confidence/stale/disputed map area the run depends on, alter the plan accordingly: add a scout/verification gate or surface it to the human as a decision — never author gates that silently trust an unverified map. Surface durable-structure choices as decision candidates per the skill's Decision candidates section rather than choosing alone. Then author the gate plan into execute.json: each gate the smallest reasonable bite, with close criteria, required evidence, and an anchors block cut from the frame. Get the human to approve it.

postconditions.statement: mission frame produced from the current map (or explicitly skipped as trivial) where architecture artifacts exist
execute.json authored, one bounded issue, gates carry anchors cut from the frame

payload.decision: Probe plan approved as consistent with Admiral launch order LO-451 (cheapest-first: read-only repro+linear probe -> feature-ablation retrain -> capacity control; gold cycles/Piece-2 excluded; small-fix=Admiral float)

compact.title: Compact context and reload skills
compact.imperative: Run /compact to compress conversation context. Then reload the constellation-commander skill into this context. Confirm it is active before proceeding to execute.

postconditions.statement: commander skill reloaded in this context

status_detail.reason: compact invokes a user-level CLI command the agent cannot run (lesson:compact-step-skip); harness auto-compaction covers it. Commander skill remains active in this context.

execute.title: Execute the plan
execute.imperative: Drive execute.json gate by gate in this conversation using this skill's gate execution instructions. Dispatch subagents only for the implementer and reviewer tasks within each gate, and NEVER hand-launch a crew: run every implementer/reviewer dispatch through python C:/Users/fredc/.claude/skills/constellation-commander/scripts/run_crew.py (foreground/blocking, durable registry, result-artifact verification). Before this step and before EACH crew dispatch, run python C:/Users/fredc/.claude/skills/constellation-commander/scripts/recover_crews.py 451 and only launch when it reports no unresolved running/resumable/conflicting crew for that work-id/gate/role/worktree; recover (resume) or explicitly abandon/relaunch any it flags. If a gate proves the plan wrong, surface the decision to the user before continuing.

postconditions.statement: every gate closed with integrated evidence

reconcile.title: Reconcile the map
reconcile.imperative: Hand the implemented changes to a subagent that invokes constellation-cartographer to fold them into the recorded architecture.

triage.title: Route future work
triage.imperative: Load the constellation-triage skill into this context. Drive triage on execute.json triage_candidates in this conversation — do not dispatch a subagent. Before creating any issues, present the full list of recommendations to the human and get explicit approval for each issue to be filed.

postconditions.statement: every triage candidate routed or recorded

review.imperative: Summarize all gates closed, changes implemented, architecture changes reconciled, and triage items routed or filed. Present the full run summary to the user. Get their confirmation before archiving.

Deliverable matches launch-order Return Shape: verdict (a) representation with per-probe harness numbers; recommendation (no fix shipped, #425 framing validated, floated to Admiral); evidence table + leakage statement; map impact (§7.6.5); 3 triage candidates routed not filed. Summary posted to issue #451 (comment 4682634759).

feedback.title: Record workflow feedback
feedback.imperative: Before committing, reflect honestly on how this run actually went: how closely you followed the skills, handoffs, and checklists; where you had to improvise or work around the instructions; what was ambiguous, missing, or contradictory; and what would have helped. Include the crew Workflow Feedback harvested at each gN-integrate. A 'none' answer requires a run-specific reason ('none — confirmed after review: <what you checked>'); bare 'none' entries fail the invariant check. Append one dated entry for this work-id to .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md (create it from templates/AGENT_FEEDBACK.template.md if absent — prefer the project copy under .agent-work/templates/, fall back to the bundled workbench template). This log persists across runs and is never archived with the work-id. Then distill into the playbook: write structured delta ops (add/confirm/disconfirm/mention/retire — every add/confirm/disconfirm cites a grounding artifact line; corroborate with engine telemetry like rework counts, BLOCK verdicts, waives where possible) to .agent-work/451/lessons-delta.json with tick=true, and apply deterministically: python C:/Users/fredc/.claude/skills/constellation-commander/scripts/apply_lessons_delta.py .agent-work/451/lessons-delta.json --file .agent-work/LESSONS.md. Never edit LESSONS.md directly; if there are no lesson candidates, still apply a tick-only delta. Route concrete interface fixes to the closeout Template Update Candidates table; lessons flagged charter-review go to a Charter refresh; constellation-scoped lessons also append to .agent-work/CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md. Then run the feedback invariant check before advancing: python C:/Users/fredc/.claude/skills/constellation-commander/scripts/verify_agent_feedback.py 451 --phase feedback.

postconditions.statement: durable feedback log exists, contains this work id, and is not inside the work area or archive

archive.title: Archive, commit, and push
archive.imperative: Commit all remaining work, including the appended .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md entry. Push the branch to remote. Move .agent-work/451/ to .agent-work/archive/<date>-451/, leaving the unified AGENT_FEEDBACK.md at the agent-work root. Run the archive-phase feedback invariant check before marking archive complete: python C:/Users/fredc/.claude/skills/constellation-commander/scripts/verify_agent_feedback.py 451 --phase archive. Confirm the branch is clean and merge-ready per repo guidance. The engine mechanically refuses closeout (c4) when the staged diff includes suspicious artifacts (oversized files, generated record dumps, disallowed dirs, binary/blob additions, large data files); if any are intentional, a human waives c4 via <engine> waive archive --cond c4 --authority human --reason "..." rather than hand-editing the spine. Finally, release the engine session lease on this spine: <engine> release --session-id <commander-session-id>.

postconditions.statement: work area archived and durable feedback log left at .agent-work root

staged diff carries no suspicious artifacts (oversized files, generated record dumps, disallowed dirs, binary/blob additions, large data files); refuse closeout unless a human waives via the engine override path
